newsitem.title: USA: Class action filed against Microtest Inc.
newsitem.headline: Class action filed against Microtest Inc.

text.p: A class action suit has begun on behalf of purchasers of Microtest Inc common stock between April 13, 1995 and January 17, 1996, lawyers for the plaintiff James Zelloe said on Tuesday.

The suit, filed in the Arizona Superior Court, alleges Microtest made misrepresentations about Microtest's business, earnings growth and financial statements and its ability to continue to achieve profitable growth.

The plaintiff claims the allegedly false statements artificially inflated the stock price allowing one of Microtest's top insiders to sell or otherwise distribute 524,500 shares of his Microtest stock at as high as $22.15 per share, for nearly $10 million.

The suit claims that when the true facts about Microtest's troubled operations, diminished profitability, and false financial statements were revealed, Microtest's stock collapsed to as low as $5 per share.
Microtest, a maker of diagnostic tools for networking cables, was not immediately available for comment.
Later on Tuesday, Microtest Chief Financial Officer Richard Douglas said the company would vigourously defend itself against the allegations.
